# No Limitz Window Tinting

> Family-owned, owner-operated window tint shop on the Merritt Island Causeway: 265 E Merritt Island Cswy, Unit 113, Merritt Island, FL 32952. Phone (407) 663-3401. Open Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM; closed Saturday and Sunday. Auto, boat and charter, heavy equipment and fleet, and home and business window tint, all with American Standard Window Films. The owner has 38 years of window tinting experience. Florida medical exemptions accepted.

## Key facts

- Name: No Limitz Window Tinting (legal name: No Limitz Window Tinting, LLC)

- At the shop: Rich and Austin

- Google rating: 4.6 from 47 reviews (checked September 2026)
- What customers say: flawless work, a walkthrough of shade levels, an immaculate shop, fair prices, done in a few hours

## Services

- Auto window tint: cars, trucks, SUVs, Teslas and classics. Ceramic film for side and rear glass, from 70% down to 5%.
- Windshield film and visor strips: ceramic windshield film in 70% (clear, glass-like appearance) or 35% (tinted appearance), and visor strips that stay above the AS-1 line.
- Boats and charters: cabin, salon and flybridge glass on boats and charter yachts.
- Heavy equipment and fleet: semi trucks, work vans, heavy equipment and fleet vehicles.
- Homes and businesses: window film for home windows, sliding doors and French doors, plus storefronts and offices.

## Florida tint guide (general guide, not legal advice)

- Front side windows: at least 28% visible light
- Rear side and rear windows: at least 15% on cars, at least 6% on SUVs, vans and trucks
- Windshield: tint only above the AS-1 line
- Source: Fla. Stat. 316.2953 and 316.2954. The shop confirms what is legal for each vehicle and accepts medical exemptions.
